purpose: Teach: 多少なりとも/殊に/ドロドロ/帰り際/頷い/はおり/わきまえ/大人しく

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんは多少なりとも社会の役に立とうとされたぞ
lines.en: Gran — when your father was young, he tried to be of use to society, even in small ways.
lines.style: Distant, remembering tone. Slow, measured pace. Slight pause before each thought, as if searching back through decades. Gentle weight on the key memory.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、殊にお孫様にはお優しかったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes — your grandfather was especially kind to the grandchildren, wasn't he, dear?
lines.style: Warm, slightly teasing affection. Soft, conversational rise at the end. Her voice carries the ease of long partnership — she's checking in with him gently.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんとドロドロの田んぼで仕事した
lines.en: Gran — when I was young, I worked with your father in those muddy rice fields.
lines.style: Voice drops quieter. The memory sits heavier — physical, real. Slow delivery. A pause before 'muddy' like he's feeling the earth again.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、お孫様の帰り際にお声をかけて下さったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Your grandfather always called out to the grandchildren as they left, didn't he, dear?
lines.style: Warm fondness. A small smile in her voice. She's painting the picture for him, drawing out the gentleness he might have forgotten.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんは私の話に静かに頷いて下さったぞ
lines.en: Gran — when I was young, your father would listen to me and nod quietly without speaking.
lines.style: Very quiet now. Almost reverent. Each phrase settles before the next. The quiet of someone honoring silence the way his father honored it.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、晩年、お正月にはおりを着てらしたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Your grandfather used to wear his formal haori on New Year's, didn't he, dear?
lines.style: Bright recall, almost playful. Her voice lifts slightly — she's seeing him in it. A touch of vanity in her affection, warm and real.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんは武士の道をわきまえてらしたぞ
lines.en: Gran — when I was young, your father understood the way of the samurai.
lines.style: Solemn, deliberate. Each word carries weight. Deep respect in the tone. Pauses between thoughts like he's making an oath.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、お年寄りの前では大人しくしていたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Your grandfather was always quiet and respectful in front of his elders, wasn't he, dear?
lines.style: Soft, affirming tone. Her voice closes gently at the end — she's describing something she saw and treasured. No performance, just recognition.
